intent.proves: At least one active product row, or one of its stock units, carries an expected delivery date.
intent.scope: all active product rows and their stock units

bindings.reason: get_product_stock reads at most 100 named products; no whole-host enumeration.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomProducts p WHERE p.ProductActive = 1 AND (p.ProductExpectedDelivery IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomStockUnit s WHERE s.StockUnitProductId = p.ProductId AND ISNULL(s.StockUnitVariantId, N'') = ISNULL(p.ProductVariantId, N'') AND s.StockUnitExpectedDelivery IS NOT NULL))
